scope: First 15 published self_hostable apps with slugs starting a-c, ordered by slug, that had no install-options row. Verified install links from official project or publisher pages. No production changes made.

records.skip_reason: The official README describes the Discord bot, permissions, and setup variables but gives no operator self-host instructions or published container image. A Dockerfile in the source tree is not an install destination.
inspection_notes: Checked the project repository README and the publisher site.
The README links an invite for using the bot and does not document a supported self-host deployment.
gaps_updates: Review and remove the Docker deployment method unless the publisher provides supported deployment instructions or a registry image.
Replace the repository link in install_docs_url if a separate installation guide becomes available.
Recheck self_hosting_status against the lack of a verified self-host installation path.

verified_install_options.label: Acontext CLI installer
verified_install_options.note: Install acontext-cli, then run acontext server up. The local server needs an LLM API key.

inspection_notes: The official local setup guide provides an install script for acontext-cli and commands to start the server.
The guide says the server creates a local db folder for persistent data.
gaps_updates: Point install_docs_url to the official local setup guide.
Replace docker and package deployment methods with binary unless separate app-server install evidence supports them.

records.skip_reason: The publisher confirms that users may self-host, but the checked GitHub README covers developer setup and has no production operator guide or published container destination. The Dockerfile is not an install destination.
inspection_notes: The publisher site explicitly describes the code as source available under the O'Saasy license and says self-hosting requires advanced technical knowledge.
The README startup steps use development tooling and bin/dev; they do not establish a supported production deployment.
gaps_updates: Change source_model from open_source to source_available and verify the license metadata against O'Saasy.
Clear the Dockerfile URL from docker_url and review the Docker method until an operator install destination is documented.
Keep the self-hostable status only with the publisher's direct self-hosting statement.

verified_install_options.label: Static-site deployment guide
verified_install_options.note: Build and publish an Aktivisda static site. The guide says a new Backtivisda image-server install currently needs developer help.

inspection_notes: The official quickstart gives static-site generation and web-server setup steps.
The same guide describes a GitLab project and CI runner as part of its full workflow, and warns that new Backtivisda server installation is currently difficult.
gaps_updates: Change deployment_methods from docker to other for the main static-site product.
Keep the Backtivisda image server described as a separate dependency, not as the main app's Docker install option.

verified_install_options.label: Docker Compose
verified_install_options.note: The guide starts the API and console together from official GHCR images.

inspection_notes: The official installation guide recommends Docker Compose and lists both the API and console image names.
The GHCR API and console package pages were also checked; the install guide is the complete destination for users.
gaps_updates: Set website_url to https://alarik.io and install_docs_url to the official installation guide.
Replace native with compose in deployment_methods.

records.skip_reason: The open-source core is a widget and server-side verification libraries integrated into another application; it is not a standalone server install. ALTCHA Sentinel is a separate commercial self-hosted product and should not be linked as the core app's install option.
inspection_notes: Official docs separate the open-source widget and libraries from commercial Sentinel.
Sentinel has its own self-hosted installation guide; it is a separate product from this core record.
gaps_updates: Keep the core app's deployment_methods empty unless the directory intentionally treats application libraries as installable apps.
Review whether ALTCHA Sentinel needs a separate directory record.

verified_install_options.label: Amgix One Docker image
verified_install_options.note: The official README documents this all-in-one image and says tag 1 tracks the latest 1.x release.

inspection_notes: The official README gives a docker run command for amgixio/amgix-one:1 and says it persists data and model caches under /data.
The Docker Hub page was not readable in the research browser; the exact image and tag are explicitly documented by the official repository.
gaps_updates: Replace native with docker in deployment_methods.
Set docker_url to the registry page and docker_image to amgixio/amgix-one:1.

gaps_updates: Clear the Dockerfile URL from docker_url.
Use the binary client as the user-facing install option and review whether deployment_methods should describe client installation or the server containers it provisions.
Point install_docs_url to an official end-user setup guide if one is selected.
